observations: Photo 0 shows a red/white mountain/dirt bicycle with front suspension fork and knobby tyres.
Front has a dual-disc style setup visible near the front wheel (appears like disc brake(s)).
Rear suspension is not clearly visible; rear looks like a rigid frame or rear shock not clearly shown.

No clear brand/model text is readable on the frame, fork, or components in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show readable branding/model text or clear evidence of '4 shockwave' wording.
Photo 0 clearly shows front suspension, but rear suspension/shocks are not clearly shown.
Front disc(s) appear present, but rear disc brake presence is not clearly visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows a drivetrain/chain and sprockets consistent with a geared bicycle.

risks.risk: Whether it is truly a dual-suspension (rear shock) bike vs front-only suspension
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear triangle showing the rear shock/suspension linkage (side view) and a photo of the rear wheel area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as front-suspension only (worst case vs seller claim).

risks.risk: Whether it has dual disc brakes (front + rear) vs only one side
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both front and rear brake rotors/calipers (rear rotor must be clearly visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as single disc brake (worst case).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in the photo (bent rim, worn tyres, brake rub, chain wear, loose headset/bearings)
risks.proof: Short video of a test ride + braking test, plus close-ups of tyres tread and chain/cassette condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing basic servicing/unknown wear (worst case).

risks.risk: Frame size and wheel size (affects value and fit)
risks.proof: Photo showing wheel size marking (e.g., 26/27.5/29) and a clear measurement or size label on the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the least desirable common size/fit based on what’s typical for the market (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear side photo of the rear suspension/shock (if any) and rear brake rotor/caliper.
Close-up photos of both brake rotors and shifters (front and rear).
Video: straight ride + hard braking to confirm brakes and gear shifting.
Photo of wheel size marking and any frame size label.
response.reason: The photo supports it being a geared mountain/dirt bike with front suspension, but key value drivers in the seller’s claims (dual suspension and dual disc brakes) are not clearly verifiable from the single image. To price confidently, we need proof of rear suspension and rear disc brake.
